annotations.text:
Late night glass, premium pass.
Italic serif wordmark replaces the P mark. Sidebar glass now has a soft vertical gradient, the composer has an edge light plus ambient and contact shadows, controls carry an inner top highlight, and a faint accent glow sits behind the bar. Inter + JetBrains Mono, accent #7C8CFF.

Earlier alternates, kept for reference.
A: every panel floats as an island. B: serif hero, no sidebar surface.
